newsitem.title: FRANCE: French TPS digital TV group orders more decoders.
newsitem.headline: French TPS digital TV group orders more decoders.

text.p: TPS, one of two French digital television groups, said it ordered more decoders from Sagem, the French electronics company, bringing to 160,000 the number of digital terminals the group has ordered from Sagem.
But a TPS spokesman declined to put a figure on the number of decoders already delivered to subscribers.
TPS, whose main backers are TF1, Lyonnaise des Eaux and M6, had ordered 20,000 decoders from Sagem last August. The offer was launched in mid-December.
On February 6, Cyrille du Peloux, TPS managing director, said TPS had signed up 48,000 subscribers.
